name: Fast Voxelization for Microgeometry
definition: A novel voxelization method optimized for sparse microgeometry that handles various input primitives (splines, textured orientation data) while maintaining memory efficiency at high resolutions.
summary: Fast Voxelization for Microgeometry is a GPU-accelerated method that voxalizes sparse microgeometry while preserving directional orientation data across multiple levels of detail, maximizing throughput beyond traditional raster-based approaches.
